Flywire Forward: A Virtual Event
Intimate discussions. Industry experts. And one major celebrity.
From the latest trends in global commerce to the future changes that will shape this industry, this is your chance to hear from some of the brightest minds in payments, banking and fintech. And as clients, we want you to have a front-row seat! ‌ On Thursday, September 16th, at 10:00 AM ET, we will open the virtual stage for Flywire Forward [https://hopin.com/events/flywire-forward?ref=2e99c0b21721], a new event that takes a forward look at the world of payments. ‌ - Hear from Sharon Butler, EVP of Global Education; Ryan Frere, EVP & GM of Healthcare; Colin Smyth, VP & GM of Travel; and John Talaga, EVP & GM of Healthcare, as they discuss the top trends taking shape across Flywire’s global industries. - Join industry luminaries like Vanessa Colella of Citi, Matt Harris of Bain Capital Ventures, and Scarlett Sieber of Money 20/20 to hear what the fintech future holds. - Sit down with Mike Massaro, Flywire’s CEO, and Karen Snow of Nasdaq to talk about Flywire’s journey to IPO and learn why the best is yet to come! ‌ Oh, and the celebrity speaker? That will be revealed soon...so get your ticket now! ‌ The event is free to attend; you can register here to save your spot: https://hopin.com/events/flywire-forward?ref=2e99c0b21721
GO FORWARD WITH US!
